question: Can the community's Tell Jokha object lead be traced to a scholarly photograph and an original report locator?
outcome: Frenez's 2023 chapter reproduces a Tell Jokha square object and cites the SAHI report's page 59, Figure 6.61. Its public panel was acquired, hashed and inspected. Original registration, material, surface-find record and dating basis remain unverified from the report body.
challenge: Author text was readable through the web tool while direct retrieval returned 403. ResearchGate PDF retrieval failed; the Academia report preview contained only front matter and its download retrieval was restricted.
remedy: Preserved the public photograph, panel coordinates, observation origins and all failed routes. Kept community-attributed object fields separate from the inspected chapter and pixels.
retry_when: Obtain the original report's object pages, a higher-resolution face/rear view or accessioned project record; compare publication orientation and material before fine sign coding.
